He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2025 class. ==Early life and high school career== Acuff was born and raised in [[Detroit]], Michigan.{{cite web|url=https://www.masslive.com/hoophallclassic/2025/01/img-academys-darius-acuff-on-his-relationship-with-arkansas-john-calipari.html?outputType=amp|title=IMG Academy’s Darius Acuff Cass Tech to a state championship.{{cite web|url=https://indiana.rivals.com/news/indiana-offers-fast-rising-25-point-guard-darius-acuff-jr-|title=Indiana offers fast-rising '25 point guard Darius Acuff Jr.|first=Mason|last=Williams|website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]]|date=May 16, 2023|access-date=October 8, 2024}} In 2023, he earned AP first-team all-state recognition and was the first sophomore to record, a second place regular season finish in the SEC, and a [[2026 SEC men's basketball tournament]] championship.https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/arkansas/men/2026.html Averaging 23.0 points per game and 6.6 assists per game, both marks that led the SEC, Acuff earned numerous conference and national awards. Acuff was named SEC Player of the Year, SEC Rookie of the Year, SEC Tournament MVP, and an AP All-American 1st team selection.https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/darius-acuff-jr-1.html In the [[2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2026 NCAA tournament]], he led the Razorbacks to the Sweet 16 with victories over [[Hawaii Rainbow Warriors basketball|Hawaii]] and [[High Point Panthers men's basketball|High Point]]. On April 5, 2026, Acuff won the [[Bob Cousy Award]], which is given to the best point guard in the nation, becoming the first Arkansas player to win the award, and the first freshman. Acuff was also a finalist for the [[Naismith College Player of the Year|Naismith Award]]. On April 22, 2026, Acuff announced he would be entering the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Medcalf |first1=Myron |title=Projected lottery pick Darius Acuff Jr. declares for NBA draft
